Messages.Author: Emmit Svenson
Messages.Body:
A ghoul in combat takes damage during the initial strike resolution
phase. Infection is played to "prevent all damage to a ghoul (ally or
retainer) in combat". The opposing minion then gains an additional
strike and damages the ghoul again. Is this damage prevented by the
already-played Infection?

In other words, does Infection prevent all damage to a ghoul for the
duration of a combat, or just the damage being applied to a ghoul at
the moment the Infection is played?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Emmit Svenson wrote:
> A ghoul in combat takes damage during the initial strike resolution
> phase. Infection is played to "prevent all damage to a ghoul (ally or
> retainer) in combat". The opposing minion then gains an additional
> strike and damages the ghoul again. Is this damage prevented by the
> already-played Infection?

No. Damage prevention cannot be saved up and spent later.

> In other words, does Infection prevent all damage to a ghoul for the
> duration of a combat, or just the damage being applied to a ghoul at
> the moment the Infection is played?

The latter.
